units.source_text: 近来她常常取出匂亲王所绘的画来观赏，每次总是对画啜泣。

en.t: Lately she often took out the paintings that Prince Niou had made and looked at them, and each time she wept over them.

units.source_text: 她左思右想，总觉得对匂亲王的因缘不会久长，

en.t: As she turned the matter over and over in her mind, she always felt that her bond with Prince Niou would not last long,

units.source_text: 但又觉得被薰大将锁闭起来而和匂亲王断绝关系，是可悲的。

en.t: yet she also felt it was sorrowful to be shut away by General Kaoru and cut off from Prince Niou.
